Recipe.Title: Dutch Oven Spanish Rice
Recipe.Yields: 6-8 Servings or 10-15 if just used as a side dish
Recipe.Source: A VanOrman Original From Grandpa John
Recipe.Description: Grandpa John created this recipe to be eaten as an Entree. It also makes a great side dish.

section.ingredient: Water 1 Quart Add more if necessary

section.instruction: Cut Green Bell Pepper into ≈¼&inches; square pieces.
Place Dutch Oven on medium amount of charcoals.
Add Hamburger and Onions and cooke until browned.
Add all other ingredients and stir well.
Stirring occastionally, simmer until Rice is cooked. (≈20-45 minutes)

Modifications.modification: For a richer taste, substitute a Poblano Pepper for the Green Bell Pepper.
